fast-mode.name: Fast object creation
fast-mode.description: Uses this mod's optimized re-implementation of object creation, group setup and the parsing thread. <cy>Turn this off and restart</cy> if objects ever look missing or wrong after a Geometry Dash update: loading then uses the game's own code (slower) but is still time-sliced.

frame-budget.name: Loading time per frame (%)
frame-budget.description: How much of each frame is spent creating objects while a level loads. <cg>Lower</cg> keeps the game responsive (smoother progress bar, no freezing). <cr>Higher</cr> loads faster but can make the frame rate drop while loading. 100 = a whole frame.

issues.info: If you encounter any issues, please report them to the Issues page on GitHub!
